title: Large Ln42 coordination nanorings: NIR luminescence sensing of metal ions and nitro explosives

synthesis.procedure: Under dry, oxygen-free dinitrogen using Schlenk techniques, dissolve Nd(OAc)3 and 2-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzaldehyde (HL) in ethanol at room temperature. Add triethylamine solution in ethanol, stir and reflux for 30 minutes, then cool and filter. Allow diethyl ether to diffuse slowly into the filtrate at room temperature. After one week, collect the pale-yellow crystals by filtration and wash with ethanol.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature during dissolution and crystallization; reflux during reaction
synthesis.time: 30 minutes at reflux; one week for crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk techniques; reflux followed by diethyl ether diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cool and filter the reaction mixture; diffuse diethyl ether into the filtrate; filter the resulting crystals and wash with ethanol (3 × 5 mL).

properties.summary: Shows ligand-centered visible emission and Nd(III) near-infrared emission. Its near-infrared luminescence is enhanced by Cd2+ and quenched by Ni2+ and nitro explosives, with particularly strong sensitivity to 2-nitrophenol.
